subject: C28
required_fixes: R1 — apps/desktop/src/styles/tokens.css:97 and apps/desktop/src/v2/v2-shell.tsx:81: below 1280px, display:none removes both the destination label and shortcut from the accessible name while the icon is aria-hidden. An in-memory production-component probe returned empty names for all seven destinations and Return to classic; available destinations also have no tooltip. Preserve accessible names and usable visible alternatives when collapsed. Acceptance: native AX and keyboard checks at 1180px, the interim minimum and 200% zoom identify every destination and the classic-interface control, with destination tooltips.

R2 — apps/desktop/src/v2/modal.tsx:37: the shared modal moves initial focus but does not contain Tab/Shift-Tab, make lower dialogs inert, or hide/inert the page siblings. With two production Modal instances, my probe moved focus from the top dialog to body and then a background button. The purported stacking test only opens one palette. Implement I8 at the shared modal boundary. Acceptance: two stacked dialogs keep keyboard interaction inside the topmost, hide/inert siblings, close only the top on Escape, and restore each opener.

R3 — apps/desktop/src/v2/toasts.tsx:25: a new onDismiss closure on each render restarts the expiry effect. A probe rerendering at 5000ms moved the deadline from 6000ms to 11000ms; the toast remained at 6100ms. Shell snapshot updates can therefore prevent expiry indefinitely without Reduce Motion. Bind expiry to the toast lifetime. Acceptance: repeated parent/snapshot renders do not extend the six-second deadline, while Reduce Motion still preserves the toast until dismissal.

R4 — apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/menu.rs:109 and apps/desktop/src/app.tsx:87: the specified Command-T tenant-switch shortcut is absent from both native menu commands and renderer handling. Add the native shortcut and route it to the existing switcher. Acceptance: Command-T opens the tenant list from any v2 destination, including after changing presentation, without executing a tenant switch.

R5 — apps/desktop/src/v2/tenant-switcher.tsx:31: opening focuses a list button, but Escape removes that button without restoring the trigger; my production-component probe ended on document.body. Selecting the already-current tenant has the same removal path. Restore a meaningful focus target on dismissal. Acceptance: keyboard opening, traversal, Escape and selecting the current tenant preserve a predictable focus sequence, with dismissal returning to Switch tenant.

R6 — crates/desktop-core/src/authority.rs:900 and packages/desktop-contracts/src/generated/Refusal.ts: C28 milestone 3 explicitly requires the tenant-switch guard refusal type, although guard behavior is deferred to C30. Refusal remains eleven payload-free strings, with no SwitchBlocked pending-decision contract. Define and generate the required structured contract without implementing C30's guard prematurely. Acceptance: Rust serialization and the contracts client's runtime validation cover the pending conversation/decision payload and reject malformed payloads.

R7 — apps/desktop/src/styles/tokens.css:77 and apps/desktop/src/v2/v2-shell.tsx:90: the current destination uses --v2-sel, which equals --v2-acc, while its focus outline is also --v2-acc inset four pixels. Keyboard focus on the current destination therefore has no distinguishable ring. Use a visible focus treatment for selected controls. Acceptance: native captures in both themes show a discernible focus indicator on every focusable shell control, including the selected destination.

R8 — tools/native-acceptance/acceptance_c28.py:228: repair the native driver's causal checks before rerunning it. Its no-tenant run expects 'First read pending', but Home renders 'Add a tenant to start reading it'; locking FIXTURE_STORE locks Keychain, whereas SetShowCalls saves through the independent FileStore and will not produce the expected refusal; two Zoom In commands add only 0.2, reaching 120%, not 200%. N03 also does not test stacked traversal or inspect a focus ring, and N07 substitutes absence of scrollbars for its specified geometry assertion. Acceptance: real fixture actions reach the intended states, effective 200% zoom is established, assertions exercise the named requirements, and a source-bound N01–N07 record reports the actual outcomes.

R9 — apps/desktop/src/app.tsx:68: new shell navigation and preference handlers reduce DeliveryOutcomeUnknown to an expiring toast, with no persistent inline 'not confirmed' state or Retry on the initiating control. This misses DESIGN-V2 section 7 and can erase the only indication of uncertain delivery. Acceptance: unknown-delivery tests preserve the initiating state and an explicit retry affordance until resolved; observation updates never cause automatic redispatch.

R10 — apps/desktop/src/v2/palette.tsx:58: arrow navigation changes aria-activedescendant without scrolling the active option into view. The thirteen destinations already exceed the list's 50vh viewport; additional tenants and zoom worsen this. Keep the selected option visible during keyboard traversal. Acceptance: native keyboard navigation reaches Settings and tenant/action entries at 100% and 200% with the active row visible, and Enter dispatches only that row.
blockers: B1 — Mandatory native acceptance is absent for the reviewed source. request.json has native_acceptance:null; no C28/native-acceptance.json exists, and the retained trees/capture predate the accessibility fix. Partial AX captures cannot close C28's native gate.

Its 670 entries omit .work/academy/.inputs shared source, apps/desktop/academy-source.ts, vitest.truth.config.ts, tools/academy/truth-graph.mjs, fixture/harness Tauri configurations and the capability manifest.
